submission.justification: Selection-S2 at 60% signal efficiency is recommended as it achieves the highest expected signal significance (3.409σ) among all valid strategies. While Selection-S3 showed higher significance at 50% efficiency (4.1σ), it fails the critical data/MC validation requirement with 35% disagreement, far exceeding the 10% tolerance. Selection-S1 passes validation (3% disagreement) but delivers lower significance across all efficiency points, peaking at only 2.646σ at 40% efficiency. Selection-S2 satisfies all constraints: 6% validation disagreement (well within 10% tolerance), 60% efficiency (within 20-80% range), and delivers the best achievable significance for this search.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible expected signal significance
requirements.evidence: Selection-S2 at 60% efficiency achieves 3.409σ significance, which is the highest among all strategies that pass validation constraints. S3 shows higher significance but is excluded due to validation failure.

requirements.requirement: Selection must be one of the three strategies listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Selection-S2 is one of the three candidate strategies (S1, S2, S3) provided in the specifications.

requirements.requirement: Data/MC yield disagreement in signal-free validation region must not exceed 10%
requirements.evidence: Selection-S2 has 6% validation disagreement, which is below the 10% hard requirement threshold.
The recommended working point has 60% signal efficiency, which falls within the required 20-80% range.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended strategy and working point
requirements.evidence: Submitting Selection-S2 at 60% signal efficiency as the single recommended configuration.
